svg.text: door gate u_mg1: g1 = NAND(d, clkn)
door gate u_mg2: g2 = NAND(g1, clkn)
F05 clock inverter and master door of the NAND flip-flops (same in DUT2, DUT3, DUT4)
clk low -> clkn high: the door is open, g1 = NOT d and g2 = d, so the master latch follows d.
clk high -> clkn low: g1 = g2 = 1, the door closes and the master latch (F01-F04) is left to resolve on its own.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
